description: Search OpenAlex's open scholarly database, or fetch specific works/authors by ID.

includeAbstract.description: Reconstruct the abstract from OpenAlex's inverted index. Costs zero extra API calls.
includeAbstract.title: Include abstract

includeAuthorships.description: Include the full authorship list (with affiliations).
includeAuthorships.title: Include authorships

includeConcepts.description: Include the topic / concept tags assigned by OpenAlex.
includeConcepts.title: Include topics / concepts

institutionIds.description: OpenAlex institution IDs prefixed with `I` (university / lab / company). Examples: `I27837315` (Univ. of Michigan), `I97018004` (Stanford), `I136199984` (Harvard), `I32971472` (MIT), `I114027177` (DeepMind). Or pass a ROR ID URL.
institutionIds.title: Institution IDs (mode=byInstitutionIds)

minCitedBy.description: Drop works with fewer citations than this.
minCitedBy.title: Min citation count

mode.title: Mode

openAccessOnly.description: Only emit works with open-access full-text available.
openAccessOnly.title: Open-access only

publicationYearMax.description: Drop works published after this year.
publicationYearMax.title: Publication year (max)

publicationYearMin.description: Drop works published before this year.
publicationYearMin.title: Publication year (min)

userAgentEmail.description: OpenAlex's polite pool requires a contact email in the User-Agent. Default works for low-volume; for production scraping, supply your own email.
userAgentEmail.title: User-Agent contact email

venueIds.description: OpenAlex source IDs prefixed with `S` (journal / repository / conference). Examples: `S4306400194` (arXiv), `S137773608` (Nature), `S99775433` (Science). Or pass an ISSN like `0028-0836` and it will be resolved.
venueIds.title: Venue / source IDs (mode=byVenueIds)

workIds.description: OpenAlex work IDs (`W123...`), DOIs, PMIDs, or PMCIDs. Examples: `W2741809807`, `https://doi.org/10.1145/3442188.3445922`, `pmid:25524000`.
workIds.title: Work IDs (mode=byWorkIds)
